verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms mail scanning, automation rules, check deposit consolidation, and forwarding-by-request (unopened mail shipped directly), which supports hold/forward workflows for nomads. However, there's no explicit mention of which carriers are accepted (USPS/UPS/FedEx/DHL) or explicit package consolidation across multiple shipments before forwarding. Missing for 10: explicit carrier acceptance list, explicit package consolidation feature description, independent hands-on confirmation of forwarding reliability.
